response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.av) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.av
